justification: Puka's listed Out, and I'm not dressing a kid who can't suit up when I've got Wan'Dale healthy and ready on the bench — that's not a knock on Puka, that's just how we fill a hole, plain and simple. Everybody else earned their spot this week and I'm not moving them off projections alone: Cousins is settled in and playing clean football, Hampton and Corum have been doing their job between the tackles, Andrews gets another week because the tape shows a guy who's still giving effort even when the box score's quiet, and Amon-Ra's dealing with a tag but he's shown up to practice and said he's good, so I trust his word over a label. McPherson earned the job and he's kept it. Clear eyes, full hearts — we go with the guys who show up.
